lines.en: I can't believe I locked myself out again.
Oh, my God. What happened here?
Well, I just thought it would make me feel good
to do something nice for my friend.
No, no, no. This is amazing.
A TV that appears as if from nowhere.
How did you afford all this stuff?
I mean, who needs a savings account?
You are the best friend anyone has ever had.
You do this. You give me the great advice.
And, hey, listen, I was thinking about what you said yesterday
No, no, no. I think I'm gonna see how things go with Kathy.
I think somebody's got a little crush on Casey.
How about I fix you two up? What do you think?
That all the pieces of my life are falling right into place.
